column1: # Chinese meanings written for Lianki for the exam decks (scripts/words/build-exam-decks.ts).
# Two kinds, both written from the word's English Wiktionary definitions (CC BY-SA 4.0):
# - words English Wiktionary has no Mandarin translation for;
# - reviewed fixes of a Wiktionary-built back whose main sense was not first,
#   was crude, or had a typo (the 4,200 most frequent words were reviewed).
# A word listed here takes this back instead of Wiktionary's. Drafted with an LLM (Claude)
# under the rules in docs/word-deck-sources.md, spot-checked by hand.
# Format: word<TAB>back, e.g. "(n.) 笔记本电脑". Words in alphabetical order.
